We are sorry that you feel this way.

We take all feedback seriously and do not dismiss concerns raised by patients. When a formal complaint is made, we review it thoroughly as a team and, where appropriate, listen to recorded calls so we can understand exactly what happened. If we identify that our service has fallen below the expected standard, we apologise and use this as an opportunity to improve our service delivery.

Google reviews can sometimes reflect frustration and may not always include the full or accurate details of an interaction, which means they do not always match the findings of a detailed internal review.
